purpose: Energy UX canonical V2 migration status. A surface may move to ready only when the backend publishes all product truth required by that surface through RHI_ENERGY_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_V2.

overview.reason: backend builder contains overview but current HA V2 sensor does not publish it

commands.reason: backend builder contains commands but current HA V2 sensor does not publish them

required_v2: layers.planning_objects or equivalent per-asset planning outcomes
planning.reason: planning payload is present but the current HA V2 surface does not expose the full per-asset planning layer needed to remove V1 planning indexes without feature loss

strategies.reason: strategy UX still depends on V1 strategy profile/effective/editable indexes

pricing.reason: pricing editor cannot move debt-free until canonical V2 exposes the complete writable property model

value.reason: value UX still depends on V1 value-accounting publication

activity_history.reason: History/Retrospective must not synthesize activity meaning in the frontend

merge_gate: All blocked_on_backend entries must be READY or explicitly OUT_OF_SCOPE with an architecture-approved reason before release.
